subject: Combining line transect data with point count for DSM?

messages.author: 6fee017125c7bf75
messages.subject: Combining line transect data with point count for DSM?
parts:
Hi all,

Wondering if anyone has tried combining line transect data with land based point count information? I would like to apply it in density surface modelling.

Part of me thinks that if I combine the observations, apply a weighted effort to the area where the point area overlaps with the transect area it might work BUT could get complicated if the detection functions are different. 

Any thoughts or suggestions would be appreciated.

Cheers,
Rowenna

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Combining line transect data with point count for DSM?
parts:
Hi Rowenna, hi listfolk,

This is possible in dsm at the moment but a bit fiddly. Probably the
easiest way to do this at the moment would be to use no detection
function object at all, but use the segment.area argument to set up the
appropriate areas*probabilities of detection (or just areas if you're
using estimated abundance as the response).

At some point soon I'll set up dsm() to use more than one detection
function, but I've not found the time yet... Point transects (with one
detection function) should be in the next major release, for those
interested.

Hope this helps.

cheers,
--dave
